Founder (Samir) built prototype: Slack bot + lightweight web UI. Uses embeddings for fuzzy search of user guides and a small code-snippet assistant.
Tried API with free credits: 2 endpoints (chat + embed) integrated in prototype; saw decent latency on staging (200-400ms for short chats).
Quoted: "Need something predictable and cheap for early users — can't justify reserved capacity."
Primary constraint: cost sensitivity — do not want surprises in per-token bills during demo day spike.
Security: wants basic audit logs and ability to delete vectors; not asking for SSO yet.
Technical notes: corpus ~15k short docs, embeddings batch size small; wants faster embedding throughput for nightly indexing job (throughput target ~1000 docs/hr).
Model preference: open to small/medium open models if cost-effective; asks about fallback to smaller quantized variants when under load.
No AE touch yet — inbound PLG lead, but assigned owner for tracking (Maya Patel).
